verdict.rationale: Composio lets developers create hosted MCP servers for their own sessions/toolkits (composio.mcp.create, sessions-via-mcp) and exposes its own Composio Connect MCP endpoint, but there is no evidence of a marketplace/registry feature where a developer publishes their own custom MCP server for other users to discover and install. missing for 10: a public server directory/registry, discovery mechanism for third-party-authored servers, and install flow for consumers of a published server.
